name: Smart Match for WooCommerce
author: wpmelon

sections.description:
Smart Match for WooCommerce uses artificial intelligence to analyze your product data and suggest the most relevant categories from your store’s existing taxonomy. Save time on manual categorization and maintain a well-organized product catalog. Categories are never applied automatically, you always review and confirm suggestions.

Features

  • AI-Powered Analysis – Analyzes product titles, descriptions, attributes, and tags
  • Multiple AI Providers – Supports both OpenAI and Anthropic (Claude) APIs
  • Confidence Scoring – Each suggestion includes a confidence percentage
  • Manual Apply – Select and apply suggested categories with one click
  • Customizable Prompts – Advanced users can adjust the AI prompt template
  • Rate Limiting – Built-in usage warnings to help manage API costs
  • Developer Friendly – Includes filters and actions for customization

How It Works

  1. Configure your preferred AI provider (OpenAI or Anthropic) in settings
  2. Navigate to any product edit screen
  3. Click “Analyze Product” in the Smart Match metabox
  4. Review AI-suggested categories with confidence scores
  5. Select and apply the categories that fit

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • An API key from OpenAI or Anthropic

External Services

This plugin connects to external AI services to analyze product data. When you click “Analyze Product”, data is sent to your selected AI provider.

OpenAI API

  • Service Website: https://openai.com
  • Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
  • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Anthropic API

  • Service Website: https://www.anthropic.com
  • Terms of Use: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

Data Transmitted:

When you analyze a product, the following data is sent to your selected AI provider:

  • Product title
  • Product short description
  • Product full description
  • Product attributes (if enabled in settings)
  • Product tags (if enabled in settings)
  • Your store’s category names and hierarchy

No customer data, order information, or personal data is ever transmitted.

Your API key is encrypted using WordPress security keys before being stored in the database.

Privacy Policy

Smart Match for WooCommerce sends product data to external AI services (OpenAI or Anthropic) when you click “Analyze Product”. This is necessary for the plugin to function.

Data transmitted includes:

  • Product title, descriptions, attributes, and tags
  • Your store’s category taxonomy (names only)

Data NOT transmitted:

  • Customer information
  • Order data
  • Payment information
  • Personal data of any kind

Your API key is encrypted using WordPress security keys before storage in the database. All communication with AI providers uses HTTPS encryption.

For complete privacy information, please review the privacy policies of your chosen AI provider linked in the Description section above.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-match-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Smart Match to configure your API key
  4. Navigate to any product edit screen to start using AI suggestions

Configuring Your API Key

For OpenAI:

  1. Visit https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
  2. Create a new API key
  3. Copy and paste it into the plugin settings

For Anthropic:

  1. Visit https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys
  2. Create a new API key
  3. Copy and paste it into the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key to use the plugin?

Yes. You must provide your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key. The plugin does not include API access.

Which AI provider should I use?

Both providers work well. OpenAI’s GPT-4o-mini is the default model and offers a good balance of cost and quality. Anthropic’s Claude 3 Haiku is a great alternative with competitive pricing.

How much does it cost to use?

The plugin itself is free. You pay only for API usage to your chosen provider. A typical product analysis costs less than $0.01 with GPT-4o-mini or Claude 3 Haiku (cost depends on product length and selected model).

Is my product data secure?

Your API key is encrypted before storage using WordPress security keys. Product data is sent directly to OpenAI or Anthropic via HTTPS. No data is stored on third-party servers beyond what’s needed for the API request.

Can I customize the AI prompt?

Yes. Advanced users can customize the prompt template in Settings > Advanced Settings. Use placeholders like {product_name}, {description}, and {category_list}.

What if the AI suggests wrong categories?

The AI provides suggestions based on your product content and existing categories. You always have full control to select which suggestions to apply. Categories are never applied automatically.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin works with all WooCommerce product types including simple, variable, grouped, and external products.

Can I exclude certain categories from suggestions?

Yes, you can exclude specific categories from being suggested in the plugin settings.

What happens if I reach the rate limit?

The plugin includes configurable rate limiting to help manage API costs. You’ll see a warning when approaching your limit. You can adjust the threshold in settings.

  • One-click category application
  • Customizable settings and prompts
  • Rate limiting and usage warnings
  • API key encryption
  • Full internationalization support
